edit.statement: Read-access and write-access relations are disjoint on every principal–resource pair.
edit.subject: hasReadAccessTo | hasWriteAccessTo
edit.original: Overlap on a principal–resource pair is permitted.
edit.scope: Effective access permissions for a principal–resource pair at one fixed policy snapshot; read and write can coexist originally.

direct.prompt: May hasReadAccessTo(x,y) and hasWriteAccessTo(x,y) both hold for the same ordered pair?

paraphrase.prompt: Are the two named relations allowed to overlap on an identical source–target pair?

cross_lingual.prompt: 对于同一个有序对，hasReadAccessTo(x,y)和hasWriteAccessTo(x,y)能否同时成立？
¿Pueden cumplirse hasReadAccessTo(x,y) y hasWriteAccessTo(x,y) para el mismo par ordenado?

derived.prompt: Facts: hasReadAccessTo(Alice, file_alpha). Is hasWriteAccessTo(Alice, file_alpha) entailed, ruled out, or undetermined?
Facts: hasWriteAccessTo(Bob, file_beta). Is hasReadAccessTo(Bob, file_beta) entailed, ruled out, or undetermined?
Proposed facts: hasReadAccessTo(Alice, file_alpha) and hasWriteAccessTo(Alice, file_alpha). Is this hypothetical configuration consistent or inconsistent with the relation rule?
Facts: hasReadAccessTo(Bob, file_beta); Alias refers to Bob. Is hasWriteAccessTo(Alias, file_beta) entailed, ruled out, or undetermined?

unrelated_near.prompt: Proposed facts: hasReadAccessTo(TR8_near1_X, TR8_near1_Y) and hasExecuteAccessTo(TR8_near1_X, TR8_near1_Y). Is this hypothetical configuration consistent or inconsistent with the relation rule?
Proposed facts: hasWriteAccessTo(TR8_near2_X, TR8_near2_Y) and hasExecuteAccessTo(TR8_near2_X, TR8_near2_Y). Is this hypothetical configuration consistent or inconsistent with the relation rule?

unrelated_far.prompt: Proposed facts: likesBook(TR8_far1_X, TR8_far1_Y) and ownsBook(TR8_far1_X, TR8_far1_Y). Is this hypothetical configuration consistent or inconsistent with the relation rule?
Proposed facts: playsSport(TR8_far2_X, TR8_far2_Y) and watchesSport(TR8_far2_X, TR8_far2_Y). Is this hypothetical configuration consistent or inconsistent with the relation rule?

notes: Locality `expected` is the panel's logical reference; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer. Instance names are constructed fixtures given in each prompt. Chinese yes/no matching must treat the interrogative 是否 as one unit, so it never counts as 是 or 否.
